description: Keep the build healthy: fix broken checks, warnings, small upgrades
leadGuide: Plan to run all checks first. If they pass, only do the specific maintenance asked (for example clean up warnings or a small dependency bump). If nothing needs doing, the right result is a short health report.
engineerGuide: Run every check first and read the output. Fix failures and warnings at their root. Do not upgrade major versions or add dependencies unless the task asks. If everything is healthy, change nothing and report that.
reviewRubric: Is the build healthier than before? Are changes low-risk and limited to maintenance? Was anything risky (major upgrades, removed checks) slipped in?
